b: One of the most anticipated moments in gaming history is coming—and we don't want you to stress about losing your Chess.com streak. From November 19 to 23, we're freezing everyone's streak so you can disappear into GTA VI on launch weekend without a single care in the (chess) world.

In case you need a refresher, Chess.com streaks count the days in a row you play or practice on the website. Whether you play another member, finish a lesson, solve a puzzle, or even use Game Review, your streak keeps growing. Normally, you can skip two days of chess without breaking your streak. But from Thursday through Monday, we're giving you five days off so you can fully dedicate yourself to GTA VI.

We're not the only ones marking the date. GTA V launched 13 years ago and became the fastest entertainment property to gross $1 billion, doing it in just three days. It has since sold about 235 million copies. Its sequel has taken eight years to build, the longest project in Rockstar's history.

The money behind GTA VI is just as staggering. While Take-Two, the company that owns Rockstar, has never disclosed the budget, estimates start at around $1 billion. But that figure looks small next to the game's expected sales. Analytics firm Newzoo projects about $3.25 billion to $5.2 billion in global sales by the end of launch week, with copies sold in its lower and main scenarios at roughly 37 million and 51 million. If they are right, many of us will be roaming around Vice City at the same time, and chess can wait a few days.
So have a great time, and enjoy every minute of the first few days of GTA VI. And if you still want some chess with neon lights and palm trees, you can challenge this month's Grand Chess Auto bots.
